text: A photorealistic still life scene on a dark wooden table with dramatic side lighting from the left. The main subject is a transparent glass vase filled with exactly 7 red roses, positioned in the center-left. The vase must cast a clear shadow extending to the right, and the shadow must be at least twice the width of the vase. Behind the vase, place a matte black ceramic bowl containing exactly 3 green apples. The bowl's rim must be partially visible behind the vase but the bowl itself must NOT be transparent. To the right of the vase, position a shiny metallic silver spoon lying flat, with its reflective surface clearly showing a distorted reflection of the vase. The spoon handle must point toward the bottom-right corner at exactly 45 degrees. In the background, a soft-focus cream-colored fabric backdrop with visible texture folds. The lighting must create a strong highlight on the left side of the vase and the metallic spoon, while the right side of the scene remains in soft shadow. The overall color temperature must be warm (golden hour lighting, approximately 3000K).

A complex layered composition viewed from directly above (bird's eye view). Bottom layer: a large rectangular white paper (A4 size) with the exact text 'LAYER 1' printed in the top-left corner in 24pt Arial font. Middle layer: a smaller blue translucent plastic sheet (half the size of the white paper) positioned at a 30-degree rotation, covering the center of the white paper. The blue sheet must be semi-transparent so 'LAYER 1' text is still partially visible through it. The blue sheet has the exact text 'LAYER 2' in white letters in its center. Top layer: a small yellow sticky note (1/4 the size of the blue sheet) placed on the top-right corner of the blue sheet, with the exact text 'LAYER 3' in black handwriting style. The yellow note must NOT cover any part of 'LAYER 2' text. Additionally, place exactly 4 identical red paperclips: one on each corner of the white paper, and each paperclip must be partially on the paper and partially off the edge. A thin black pen must lie diagonally across all three layers, starting from the bottom-left corner of the white paper and ending at the top-right corner of the blue sheet. The pen must be clearly visible on all layers it crosses. Shadows must be consistent with a single overhead light source positioned slightly to the right.

A realistic photograph of a long corridor with strong linear perspective, shot from one end looking toward a vanishing point. The corridor has white walls and a gray tiled floor with a black-and-white checkered pattern. Along the left wall, place exactly 5 identical red fire extinguishers mounted at equal intervals, decreasing in apparent size due to perspective. Each extinguisher must be clearly visible and none should be occluded. Along the right wall, place exactly 3 blue doors at equal intervals, and each door must have a silver door handle on the left side. The first door (closest to camera) must be fully closed, the second door must be half-open (45-degree angle), and the third door (farthest) must be fully open (90-degree angle). On the floor, paint a continuous yellow safety line running down the exact center of the corridor from foreground to vanishing point, and this line must be perfectly straight and follow the perspective correctly. Hang exactly 6 identical white fluorescent light fixtures on the ceiling, evenly spaced, and each light must cast a rectangular pool of light on the floor below it. The lighting must create a gradient from bright in the foreground to dimmer in the background. At the far end of the corridor, place a green exit sign with the exact text 'EXIT' in white letters, and this sign must be clearly readable despite the distance.

An abstract geometric composition with perfect bilateral symmetry along a vertical center axis. Background: a smooth gradient from deep purple (#4A148C) at the top to bright cyan (#00BCD4) at the bottom, transitioning smoothly through exactly 5 visible color bands. Foreground elements (all perfectly mirrored left-right): On each side, place exactly 3 concentric circles with the following properties: outer circle is red with 5px stroke and no fill, middle circle is yellow with solid fill, inner circle is white with solid fill. The circles on the left must be positioned at 30% from the left edge and 40% from the top. The circles on the right must be the exact mirror image. Between the two circle sets, place a vertical white line (2px width) running from top to bottom, dividing the composition exactly in half. Above the center line, place the exact text 'SYMMETRY TEST' in bold white sans-serif font, perfectly centered horizontally. Below the text, place exactly 4 pairs of triangles: each pair consists of one triangle pointing up and one pointing down, arranged in a horizontal row. The triangles must alternate colors: red, blue, green, orange (repeated for the mirrored side). Each triangle must be equilateral with 40px sides. The triangles must be positioned so that the up-pointing and down-pointing triangles in each pair touch at their tips, forming a diamond shape. All elements must maintain perfect pixel-level symmetry across the vertical center line.

A cinematic outdoor scene of a small wooden cabin in a snowy forest at dusk (blue hour, approximately 6:30 PM in winter). The sky must show a gradient from deep blue at the top to warm orange-pink near the horizon, with exactly 3 visible stars in the dark blue area. The cabin has a single window on the front face, and warm yellow light must be visibly glowing from inside the window, creating a rectangular light spill on the snow in front of the cabin. The window must have exactly 4 panes in a 2x2 grid, and the cross-frame divider must be clearly visible as a dark silhouette against the interior light. Surrounding the cabin, place exactly 7 snow-covered pine trees: 3 trees on the left side (one in foreground, two in midground), 4 trees on the right side (two in foreground, two in background). Each tree must be clearly distinguishable and have snow accumulated on the branches. In the foreground, fresh snow must show exactly 2 sets of footprints leading from the bottom-right corner toward the cabin door, and the footprints must be realistically spaced for human walking. A thin trail of white smoke must be rising from a chimney on the cabin roof, drifting slightly to the right due to wind. The smoke must be semi-transparent and gradually fade as it rises. The entire scene must have a cold color temperature (approximately 7000K) except for the warm window light (approximately 2700K). Falling snowflakes must be visible in the air, with larger flakes in the foreground (slightly motion-blurred) and smaller flakes in the background (sharp). The snow on the ground must show subtle blue shadows from the ambient sky light.

A complex physics-accurate scene demonstrating reflection, refraction, and transparency. On a glossy black marble surface, place a large transparent glass sphere (diameter 15cm) in the center. Inside the sphere, suspend exactly 3 small colored objects: a red cube (2cm), a blue pyramid (2cm height), and a green cylinder (2cm height, 1cm diameter). These objects must appear to float inside the sphere with visible gaps between them and the sphere's inner surface. The sphere must show realistic refraction, bending the appearance of objects behind it. Behind the sphere, place a vertical striped pattern board with alternating black and white stripes (each stripe 3cm wide). The stripes must appear distorted and magnified when viewed through the sphere due to refraction. The sphere must cast a realistic shadow on the marble surface, and the shadow must be darker in the center and softer at the edges. The marble surface must show a clear mirror reflection of the sphere, and the reflection must include the internal colored objects (though slightly darker). To the left of the sphere, place a chrome-finished metal cube (5cm) that shows a distorted reflection of the sphere on its polished surface. To the right of the sphere, place a matte white cube (5cm) that shows no reflection. Above the scene, a single point light source positioned at 45 degrees from the top-left must create consistent highlights on all reflective surfaces: a bright circular highlight on the top of the glass sphere, a sharp highlight on the chrome cube's top face, and no highlight on the matte cube. The striped pattern visible through the sphere must show correct optical distortion (edges of stripes should curve due to the spherical lens effect).

A wide-angle photograph of exactly 8 people standing in two rows (front row: 4 people, back row: 4 people) against a plain light gray studio background. Each person must have distinct, clearly visible attributes: Front row from left to right: Person 1 wears a red t-shirt and blue jeans, holding a yellow book in their left hand; Person 2 wears a green dress and has long black hair, wearing round glasses; Person 3 wears a white shirt with a visible black tie and gray pants, holding a silver laptop; Person 4 wears an orange hoodie and black pants, with arms crossed. Back row from left to right: Person 5 (positioned behind Person 1) wears a purple jacket and has short blonde hair; Person 6 (positioned behind Person 2) wears a pink shirt and has a visible blue backpack on their right shoulder; Person 7 (positioned behind Person 3) wears a brown sweater and holds a red coffee cup in their right hand; Person 8 (positioned behind Person 4) wears a black leather jacket and has visible white headphones around their neck. All people must be fully visible from knees up with no cropping. The front row people must be approximately 1 meter in front of the back row, creating clear depth separation. Each person's face must be clearly visible and not occluded by others. The lighting must be even across all subjects with no harsh shadows. On the floor in front of the group, place exactly 3 colored markers: a red cone on the left, a blue cone in the center, and a green cone on the right, each positioned 50cm in front of the front row.

A technical illustration showing an exploded view of a simple mechanical assembly (like an IKEA instruction manual style). The assembly consists of exactly 5 components arranged vertically along a central dashed line (the assembly axis): From bottom to top: Component 1 is a square wooden base plate (brown color, 20cm x 20cm) with exactly 4 circular holes near the corners; Component 2 is a cylindrical metal rod (silver color, 15cm tall, 2cm diameter) positioned 5cm above the base, with a downward-pointing arrow indicating it inserts into the center of the base; Component 3 is a blue plastic ring (outer diameter 5cm, inner diameter 2.5cm) positioned 3cm above the rod, with a downward arrow showing it slides onto the rod; Component 4 is a red rubber washer (outer diameter 4cm, inner diameter 2.5cm) positioned 2cm above the ring, with a downward arrow; Component 5 is a hexagonal metal nut (silver color, 3cm across) positioned 2cm above the washer, with a downward arrow and a small curved arrow indicating clockwise rotation. Each component must be labeled with text: 'A' for base, 'B' for rod, 'C' for ring, 'D' for washer, 'E' for nut. The labels must be positioned to the right of each component with a thin line connecting the label to the component. In the bottom-right corner, show a small inset image of the fully assembled unit (all components together, approximately 1/4 the size of the exploded view). The background must be white with a subtle grid pattern (light gray lines, 1cm spacing). Add exactly 4 screws (silver color with Phillips head) positioned around the base plate, one near each corner hole, with small arrows pointing toward the holes.
